notes.title: SuchArt - Neon Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/83e1c26f835305b3af7a9367dfd4f996fdcd4940.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, we're happy to bring you new free update for SuchArt!

[h2]Neon paint[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/c3f505ee051f0b9e0f5bb7367715a2425cb03886.png[/img]
The year is 2130, and a new technological breakthrough has made its way into your gifted hands. Neon paint is now available from every paint dispenser and is ready to be used within and beyond reason.

[h2]Customizable Gallery lights[/h2]
Is the mood of your gallery not right? Do you think a dimmer light would better suit your tastefully neon-enhanced paintings? 

Say no more: the spot lights of your gallery upper floor can now be tweaked to your liking, at any moment.

[h2]Stencils extension[/h2]
This update sees the retirement of the various stencil packs that you could buy from the shop. Instead, the holostencil has been reworked and is now the king of all stencils, with:

[list]
[*] A ton of new stencils, including letters and numbers
[*] A bigger size range
[*] A slightly transparent material for easier positioning
[*] A cheaper price
[/list]
[h2]Canvas colors[/h2]
When requesting a new canvas, you can now choose the color you want to receive it in.

Not only a potential gain of time, this feature should also allow you to paint over the background color of your choice and then reveal it using various erasing tools, as opposed to the default white canvas. This should bring a new side use to erasing tools.

[h2]Tools labels[/h2]
As an effort to improve tips and communication between players, every tool now displays their official in-game name under their inventory icon, when selected.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare white flash flickering from some meshes
[*] Fixed a painting issue with part of a Hangar wall
[*] Fixed game version display not being properly aligned in the main menu, for some resolutions
[*] Fixed marker color of the adjustable walls and blocks of the gallery’s B wing. This could happen after using the color wand on some elements of the A wing.
[/list]

[h2]HypeTrain Summer Sale 2024[/h2]

Missing the Summer Sale already? So are we, that's why HypeTrain is throwing its own: from July 15 to July 29, most of the publisher's games will be available at a nice discount. Don't miss your chance to restock your Steam library with some indie gems!

notes.title: Miserable Artist DLC and Summer update
notes.content:
Heya,

Long time no see! We haven’t been in touch for a while, but here we are back from nowhere for a fresh update!

[h1]The Miserable Artist (free) DLC[/h1]

Are your clients treating you too well? Do you think you deserve less praise, and a whole lot more pettiness? Then the Miserable Artist Experience DLC is here to fix that for you. 

The Miserable Artist DLC offers you to discover a fresh take on the game’s story, and experience the life of a maybe-not-so-genius artist, after all. 

Brace yourself for awfully mean, entitled clients and start developing your personal coping strategy already. Will you ignore the pettiness, accept it, slack off and make low effort paintings, stay convinced of your well hidden deep down genius, or paint aggressive paintings in retaliation? Only you will tell.

This totally optional and free DLC should be taken as a humoristic alternative take on the game. Enable the DLC and start a new game to try it out! And if you find out it is not for you (fair enough), then it is always possible to disable it mid playthrough without losing any progress.

The Miserable Artist experience is only available in English.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478320/SuchArt__Miserable_Artist_Experience/

[h1]The Summer update (2.1.0.0)[/h1]

[h2]Frame your paintings[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/381d82f8d38e918e6457144d289b7070e744cbf5.png[/img]

One of your oldest requests finally made it to the game! 

The painting-framing tool is now available in your gallery and waiting for you. Choose any combination of 35 different frames and 29 materials to fit the best frame on each and any of your paintings.

With 5 different categories of frames and 4 categories of materials, we sure hope you’ll find something to your liking!

[h2]Did you say Jetpack?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/c5681ece559a3d98a4684fd3955b8b19cbcd2c0e.png[/img]

Experience the most stable, noiseless and apartment-friendly jetpack of them all.

The release of the Hangar update got you a spacious hangar and large items to paint, only to expect you to fight artificial gravity with some primitive ladders? No more!

Your new Jetpack station is waiting for you in the Hangar if you got the credits for it. No more excuses, ceiling is the limit!

[h2]More commissions variety[/h2]

A good amount of commissions’ variety has been added to the portrait-less clients. More topics and style requests are waiting to be explored!

[h2]That’s it[/h2]

This and also various bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Petbot will now wake up if burned or scared by a explosion
[*] Fixed a situation in which PetBot would sleep with its eyes open
[*] Gallery lighting improvements
[*] Fixed two retractable walls in the gallery that were duplicated
[*] Fixed two retractable wall markers were not visible
[*] Fixed the portable paint machine palette holder going into a wrong angle if turned while the machine was tilted
[*] Fixed a small unpaintable line on the small 1-2 canvas
[*] Better cursor speed and size across different screen resolutions
[*] Fixed "No reviews yet" shop entries not being localized
[*] Fixed bought items would never disappear from the shopping screen when bought in Creative mode
[*] Fixed the last radio page creadits was not shown
[*] Fixed duct tape would not get destroyed along paintings in incinerator, etc
[*] Fixed a rare bug that could break multiple things in the game
[/list]

And that should be it for now. We hope you enjoy everything we’ve prepared for you today and, of course, wish you a lovely painting day!

notes.title: Full Game Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d01d3830acba925c4fa0421e68d0607391a1cb18.jpg[/img]

Heya,

The day has come: SuchArt is now fully and officially out. Thank you so much for supporting us all the way through the Early Access – the game wouldn’t reach its current state without your feedback, as well as there would be no community without you actively participating in the life of the [url=https://discord.gg/T4jZyTQ]SuchArt discord server[/url] and painting your masterpieces. So yeah, your contribution cannot be overestimated, and we truly appreciate it.

[previewyoutube=0F_GxnR9I28;full][/previewyoutube]

Since today is a big day indeed, you can grab SuchArt with a 20% launch discount. Moreover, you can get an additional 15% off if you purchase it as a part of our bundle with House Flipper – quite a bargain, isn’t it?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

Don’t forget that we’re also running a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293180/view/3556180117860357344]contest[/url] in which you can win SuchArt Steam key and help us spread the word about the game at the same time – make sure to check it out!

But let’s move to the most interesting part – the new stuff we promised to tell you about (spoiler: no worries, your saves should remain safe and sound!).

[h3]Hangar[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/99a832af302d3ab2303eb59c9c1179a82fdd6b6c.png[/img]

The hangar is a new spacious area distinct from your studio. A new space with its own game mechanics, items, characters and commissions. It brings larger and more complex items to paint in game, and aims to bring more variety to the mid and late game.

=> It is unlocked shortly after reaching the 4th level of fame. You will get an email from a new character. If you load a save past this level of fame, you should quickly receive the email as well. It is also always available in Creative mode.

[h3]Gallery rework[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/7b35cd967d34391eccbe2e53bca214d65dfae188.png[/img]

The gallery has been reworked and expanded. It is now much bigger, and has a new area with its distinct atmosphere and display mechanics.

[h3]The Virtualizer[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/0502df36cd70226460844b7fa6e2052c65232e8f.png[/img]

The virtualizer is a new tool which you can use to get a copy, in your gallery, of furniture and other decorative items that you possess in your studio. For a small fee.

It is available in the shop, in the “workshop” tab.

[h3]The Omni Shield[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/879b696d7de9ece040384454903501437f3865a7.png[/img]

The Omni Shield is a new tool. Its advanced technology allows you to protect any surface of your choice from being painted. Blow up those spray cans safely!

It is available in the shop, in the “workshop” tab.

[h3]Other changes and additions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d489194f5840b04c3b3e8a7e960f4f93a36448a6.png[/img]

- The studio has been reworked to offer more space in the main area
- The corridor and elevator can now be accessed again after the introduction
- Unique items from the Story mode are now also available in the Creative mode, from the shop
- Shop: shorter and universal delivery times, replaced delivery timer with a progress bar
- Added step ladders in the shop
- Added 5 new pieces of furniture in the shop
- Lowered the price of many furniture items
- Re-organized the shop categories
- Updated lacquer sprays and added multiple cap variants (now similar to the regular spray cans)
- Faster running speed
- Various optimizations
- Cleaner canvases models

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

- Tablet support has been improved and should work properly with more devices / setups
- Fixed partially broken Journal UI for some screen resolutions
- Fixed some game credit entries
- Fixed some obscure PetBot issues
- Range of minor / other fixes

[h3]Saves compatibility[/h3]

Your old saves should be compatible with the update, with a few quirks:
- Some items may be relocated during the update
- A few walls and floors in the studio (main room, downstairs) have been remodelled for the studio enlargement. Anything you have painted there (walls, floor, ceiling, window, etc) will likely be altered with the update.


If you come across any issues or bugs, please report them either on our Discord server or in the comment below this post, cheers.

We hope you have a fantastic artistic journey – bon voyage!

notes.title: PetBot Updaaaate!
notes.content:
Hello!

Do we have some news for you! Here comes our latest update, “PetBot”! In short, PetBot received some love, there are some cool new items, and a whole bunch of fixes and optimization. No time to waste, let’s get this canvas going!

[h2]PetBot[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/b58f7170dd1ee24ec30c27a31f44529024405d7c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/87ba785a0f0ff860c4547a477cd87512e169985c.gif[/img]

The PetBot is now more interactive. You can give it pets! You can customize it better! Play ball! Kyndle in Babazone might have something for it too…go ahead and find out!

[h2]Canzooka![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/ef5b02732ca6fd0ed98706b6659928d2b7b86b7b.gif[/img]

Lock and load, time to blast some paint! Indulge in creative chaos with the Canzooka and launch entire paint cans at the canvas. What can go wrong?

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]

Because we like it smooooth. Clean all the paint off with a single tap on a button, get more frames during paint can explosions, and get a bit more frames in general.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

Just some small stuff. Typos, controls, pesky bugs, that sort of thing.
And that’s it for now! As always, do let us know what you think in the Hub.

Lots of love, go creative! 

[h3]PS: Here’s the full changelog:
[/h3]
PetBot

- There are rumors about Kyndle opening her own brand of items for PetBot directly in Babazone. Who knows, maybe you will receive an email from her about it?
- You can now pet your Petbot to reward it for being cute.
- A new purchasable PetBot module has been added, allowing you to change the color of PetBot’s eyes and lights.
- You can play ball with PetBot!
- PetBot will react to some things getting broken or exploding near it.
- PetBot should now be a bit easier to paint. Any paint already present on it will likely be altered because of the changes.
- Minor PetBot changes.

Other new items

- The totally safe Canzooka has been added to the shop.
- A new ball has been added to the shop.

Optimization

- A button has been added in the options to clean all the walls, floor, ceiling, etc from paint. This is intended for players who find their game getting laggy after painting too many surfaces and who want to reset the textures without losing the ability to paint them again.
- Spray cans explosions should be a bit less violent for your frame rate.
- A bit of additional optimization for some painted surfaces.

Other Changes

- While painting, you can now freeze the rotation of your brush at any moment.
- Screenshots taken with the camera now have a better definition (x1.5).
- Emails: added a marker on the “Important” emails category if any important email is currently unread or left without an answer.
- Adjusted the volume of some buzzing and humming noises in the studio.
- The delivery system should be more robust now (less likely to get clogged).
- To save everyone’s eyes, the “VR” transition to the gallery is not bright white anymore.
- The glitchy ball got its maximum velocity lowered a bit.

Fixes

- Fixed ray of the Steam cleaner not always rendering properly.
- Holo stencils should not clip through other surfaces as easily, plus some other minor Holo stencils adjustments.
- Fixed one of the palette knives that was not making splashing noises and effects when cleaned in a bucket.
- Fixed some typos and text related issues.
- Fixed controller related options not showing up at the right place (if a controller is detected and used).
- Fixed delivered tool box shelves being smaller than they should, then getting back to their proper size after reloading.
- Fixed could crouch inside the incinerator and activate it.
- Fixed PetBot lights on arms sometimes not displaying properly.

notes.title: Ver. 1.5.0.0 - Graphics Tablet Update
notes.content:
Hey there!

Again, long time no see, but this pause has been justified — we’re coming back with a very handy feature many of you have been looking forward to. Well, okay, there’s probably no point in keeping it a mystery since it’s all in the title, so let’s just make it 100% clear: SuchArt now officially supports graphics tablets, yay!

[h3]A few words about tablet support[/h3]

So, we’ve added tablet support with two different possible behaviours: “Basic” or “Advanced”, to choose according to your preferences. Using a tablet allows for more precise control of your brushes, and supports pressure for most of the tools!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/e7f9aeaa8163f9bca24369e7a435e46b54b33ff4.png[/img]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] The different MyManager modes (to receive more or less commissions) can now last much longer
[*] Looking up or down doesn’t slow down your movement anymore
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] You cannot get your PetBot stuck in the trash compactor anymore!
[*] Fixed/Improved using some precise brushes could leave a stroke of paint instead of a dot on some specific angles
[*] Fixed picking paint from palette on a portable paint dispenser was a bit buggy 
[*] Fixed some rare potential crashes
[*] Minor changes to the keyboard/controller choice popup. This might prevent some issues for some players.
[/list]

And that’s it for today! Make sure to try using your tablet in SuchArt and share your results and feedback with us. Also, don’t forget about the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293180/view/3073137349161107767]contest we’re running together with our friends from LEAP Games[/url] — that actually might be the perfect occasion to get your tablet out.


Finally, there's a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/hypetrain]HypeTrain Digital Publisher Sale[/url] going on until Nov 8, during which you can grab SuchArt and many other awesome titles with great discounts — go check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/3457d65a1accb112ea07d9b859bd79cead005822.gif[/img]

And now that’s definitely it, I swear. Have a beautiful day, and may the inspiration be with you!

notes.title: When is SuchArt coming out?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/c87ae3f8a5f9b3b518b200ebe35d630866031a99.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

We know that many of you have been waiting for SuchArt to be released for quite a while now — we get lots of questions about the release date/time every day, we see all of them, yet we can’t give a proper answer, which can possibly be quite disturbing for you. What we definitely don’t want is you being disturbed, that’s why we believe it’s the right time to share our release plans and explain why we’re not giving any specific dates just yet.

First of all, we’d like to reassure you a bit: the game itself is stable — all the core features are ready, and we’re now mainly adding new languages and fixing some minor bugs. Thanks to our awesome Discord community we managed to select people who’ve been helping us with the game testing over the past months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/1f10b268d1aa250c907cac3d8cf0cb889c2ad439.gif[/img]
[i]Please be kind to your PetBot![/i]

There’ll be a lot of stuff awaiting you upon release: a complete story campaign, a separate Creative Mode, a lovely robot assistant PetBot, and many other features related to painting and customizing your studio. Despite all this, SuchArt is likely to be released as an Early Access game. Not because it’s not finished, but because we’re planning to continue adding new features and opportunities to the game based on your future feedback, and Early Access seems to be the best option for such continuous improvements. 

In order for the game to be successful, we need to pick the best release date possible, so it’s one of the most crucial tasks for us at the moment. Release on a bad day can be critical for a small project like ours — there’s always a chance of getting lost among other releases and not getting enough attention and sales at the start (and the first days after the release are actually the most important ones). May and June happened to be extremely replete with releases and other gaming-related events: that’s why we have already postponed SuchArt release several times.

We’ve got a date in mind which we’re now aiming for (don’t worry, it’s in the foreseeable future), and we intend to announce it two weeks before the due date, [b]when we’re 100% sure it won’t change[/b]. We really hope you understand and share our concerns and caution. 

Anyway, thank you so much for looking forward to the full version of SuchArt — it’ll be out pretty soon, just wait a tiny bit more. And you’ll love it, promise!

As usual, this is not an exhaustive list of all the awesome works out there, so please don’t get discouraged or offended if we didn’t include your painting in it — it absolutely doesn’t mean that you’re doing something wrong, we simply can’t include everything (even if we want to). Yet you’re all making great art, and may it always be so!

P.P.S. This time there are really only 10 initially declared paintings — no more misleading titles and clickbait lol[/i]

[h3]Jin-Hoon[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/72282d3ddd8065088c84546969fbb77c350493f3.png[/img]

Do I really have to comment on this one? I mean, everything here is great and harmonious: a penguin, a sardine, the colours Jin-Hoon used. Although I do feel a bit sorry for the sardine, but let’s just not think what happened to it afterwards...

[h3]glitchWitch[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/8be4f5d5d13e4c06abca5c97b7ecbb15942cb2a7.jpg[/img]

This work has such a strong Chagall vibe to it, doesn’t it? It’s almost as if you’re seeing a dream where you swap with a cat, and now it’s gloating about taking your place under a blanket. And I love animals sleeping under the blankets, it’s cute. 

[h3]1lannah[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/b32b42ec32dabc72629c4cb9230e0e74886bf32b.jpg[/img]

Honestly, I thought this was a photo when I first saw it. This is a work of incredible technical quality — to think that it was created in the game which was never conceived as a professional painting tool and doesn’t have nearly as many features/instruments as, say, photoshop does… 1lannah, you’re amazing!

[h3]P.Pudding[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/7045044b5945aeb2d8a7e7b5eb591011dde6eb0b.jpg[/img]

I adore the colour scheme here, the pic is just so pleasant to look at. And I must admit that this whale is incredibly cute, although it’s probably not meant to be (yep, cute things are my weak spot).

[h3]just-an-olliepop[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/efb3cab4ef8b123e495a05398a9d3029ec0771be.jpg[/img]

The whole series of Japanese-themed ink paintings by just-an-olliepop turned out to be wonderful, but I had to pick one, and here it is. Minimalistic, yet vivid and really authentic!

[h3]Okuri1nu[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/5797f262698dc45e8588923d0acbb93754514ccf.jpg[/img]

You saw my confession about cute things earlier. And if whales are, like, not obviously cute, shibas are born to be cute. So this is kind of a sucker punch. But again, it’s an overly beautifully-painted shiba, so that’s fine.

[h3]Dm7[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/223de635d39235013bbb4521e6a6fcd0c6724fbc.jpg[/img]

This is the only mural in this top, and it’s superb — such a subtle usage of colours and light deserves tons of respect. And it gets it! 

[h3]조성근[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/75eaa78857f2de69211a17020c513820d00b0505.jpg[/img]

This is Squidward. A very modern one. I really like how big strokes that look even kinda messy up close transform into a really balanced and clear picture with sharp lighting the further you move away from it. And yes, this is a compliment!

[h3]Fern[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/37f86dca11d656cf58a19680276f542e29296096.jpg[/img]

Okay, I don’t know if there’s something wrong with me, but when I see this painting, I immediately think of the northern renaissance but with anthropomorphic cats instead of people. That’d be a hell of an interesting era to live in! And the painting itself is amazing — I really love the drapery here, looks fantastic.

[h3]Mariberri[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d873e3686340a523ec92780f1aeb3423f32cc799.jpg[/img]

I love the style of this work, it’s quite unique — the combination of different colours and textures looks really refreshing.

-----------------------------

And that’s it for November (yep, no extras, I told you)! Hope you guys loved these paintings as much as we did. As usual, don’t forget to:

And you’re reading this either to look at cool pics or find yourself on the list, right? So who cares about the number thing at all. 

Anyway, our discord server where we’re giving out demo keys (if you see this during the Steam Autumn Festival, pls note that you can get permanent access to the demo there) and where people share their paintings has grown quite a bit: in the August top we wrote that we almost hit 1k, but now it’s already more than 2.7k members, isn’t it awesome? [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/02088fd424561eaa23a48cd0265f59b32603d23a.jpg[/img]

I’ll be honest, i’m a quite big anime fan, so painting Korosensei from assasination classroom was pretty much enough to melt my heart. Moreover, the painting itself is really detailed, bright and clear. Combo!

It’s one of the most professional murals created in SuchArt I’ve seen so far — everything including the lines is so clear and precise, and the choice of colours is perfect. Like, even if I wanted to find weak spots here, I simply can’t. 

[h3]We-Cool-Beans[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/f462f7815b9bb75dcca4e5d943b1115fc5874ec0.jpg[/img]

Super relaxing pastel colours, clouds, glitter — have I died and gone to heaven?

[h2]Extra[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/a572cb0bf1a2e1110ff6e006d38240b3d3a1e7ea.png[/img]

I had to make an extra category for this one — it gets the “best copy of a masterpiece” award. I still smile every time I see it. And that’s saying a lot, because my favourite meme made me smile only for the first 3 times. Seriously, it’s amazing!



And, I guess, that’s it for September. Of course we could have added many more great works, but this post isn’t infinite, right? So don’t worry if you haven’t made it to this top — I’m 100% sure we’ll see you in the later ones! 

Don’t forget to join our discord, participate in #SuchArtober, follow us on Twitter and, of course, wishlist the game if you like it — this is the best possible way to support the project at the moment. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

Thank you so much for your attention, and see you soon!

notes.title: What is SuchArt?
notes.content:
In SuchArt you are a genius artist living in the year 2130. Make the best of the space studio you own. Create art with a large variety of tools, sell your works, get famous and upgrade your studio! Let your imagination run wild and create the art of your dreams!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/58eec9f3b1771872af7c94beb1b8d603f48ce8ec.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

[h1]PAINT EVERYWHERE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/96cd825b74cb2349a0c0d6d1c133839ee0349409.jpg[/img]
Turn the world around you into a huge canvas and do whatever you please with it — add some red to that gloomy wall, spill paint on the floor and call it abstract expressionism, or start a collection of alphabet paintings from A to Z: this place is yours after all! Wait, how did you mess up your studio that much that fast?

[h1]UPGRADE AND DESIGN YOUR STUDIO[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/555228d118afcda11a3279a45cab6149da84ffc3.jpg[/img]
Not satisfied with the initial look and/or functionality of your studio? That’s okay, because you can always unlock new rooms, buy some furniture and decorations, and place those however and wherever you want — make yourself at home! Wait, what do you mean you don’t have enough money?!


[h1]SELL AND EXPOSE YOUR ART[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/f20219376a6372e5355d7462fa30c401f84a89f2.jpg[/img]
Sell your paintings at the marketplace, fulfill all your clients' orders, and receive a generous commission, or maybe a gift! Or maybe some exposure, the best of all currencies out there. Don't forget that you can exhibit your amazing art and see what critics have to say about it.

[h1]REALISTIC PAINTING[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/e7ee545279c21d5b959a1e90fff349a15e40e3d6.jpg[/img]
Painting in SuchArt feels just like in real life, but without the downsides. The colors mix as you would naturally expect them to, so you can easily achieve the result you dreamed about. The paint has realistic texture, and each instrument alters it a bit with different strokes. There’s plenty of instruments to choose from: brushes, palette knives, stencils or even flamethrowers to create your next masterpiece.

[h1]PICK YOUR SIDE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/0f49c88b9ef6d3f87dfd178017d69bba2203de39.jpg[/img]
They say down on Earth the robots are revolting and the Crabuxes covet the planet’s saltwater. But surely that’s none of your business. Or, is it?

notes.title: Top 10 August Paintings From SuchArt Community

SuchArt discord server (the place we’re taking all the masterpieces below from) is constantly growing, and we almost hit 1k members now — no wonder there were so many good paintings last month. Lastly, a quick reminder that we’re still giving out SuchArt demos each Friday on our discord, which you can join here: discord.gg/4vTRcfS

notes.title: Top 10 July Paintings From SuchArt Community
notes.content:
Hi there! 

Long time no see, right? We haven’t done a lot of Steam posts recently (sorry for that), but our Discord server (a.k.a our main community hub) is live, well and quite active. We’re sending out SuchArt demo keys there every Friday, people play the demo, discuss it, share their experience and, most importantly, share their paintings with us. And as a matter of fact, lots of those paintings turn out to be really beautiful! 

You don’t have to be a fortune teller to guess that this post was designed to:

[olist]
[*] Remind you about our cool Discord server, which you can join here: [url=discord.gg/4vTRcfS]discord.gg/4vTRcfS[/url]
[*] Share the masterpieces made by our community’s members
[/olist]

This top won’t have any grading, and the order doesn’t really mean anything (we just thought it’d look nice this way). So if you’re on the list — congrats, your artistic potential has been acknowledged! And if you’re not, don’t worry, we’re sure you’ll make it next time :) 

[h3]By Sparky[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/f38b8a2b4f81ba1c0d165e59612605cac2ac7f2d.jpg[/img]

This one makes you kinda regret that you’re not an alpinist. We really liked how Sparky used light and shadows in order to give additional volume to the mountains. And the colour scheme is so nice as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/17816ea19eb0ede557d1e2d3b5c0903bd136f9ba.png[/img]

A gorgeous black and white portrait of a serious man. We don’t know who he is, but there’s one thing we know for sure: Datura is good at working with colours and shading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/969fffd85d3f712e241198eda33a9ee63834bcf3.png[/img]

Voidtrain is a first-person action/survival game where you become a crew member of an interdimensional express. Build your own train, upgrade it, craft weapons and travel across different mysterious worlds full of outlandish creatures, Nazis and other dangers. 

https://youtu.be/o0bIODWSX5Y

Tunche is a charming, hand-drawn beat'em up hack and slash game with roguelike elements, co-op and a pinch of shaman witchcraft. Visit the amazonian jungle alone or together with your friends, choose one of the 5 unique characters and hack through hordes of enemies!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0yOLVvhsJFw

In order to do so, she has to uncover all the 7 seals of Black Book — a demonic artefact, said to be powerful enough to grant any wish.

notes.title: SuchArt! Demo available during the Steam Games Festival!
notes.content:
Hi there, 

My name is Vincent, I am a 25 year old French national and I’m making SuchArt! —  a painting sim game where a player starts off as an amazing artist with their own new studio aboard the Space City. SuchArt! is a single-person project. From the game mechanics to programming, 3D modeling, writing or audio, I have now spent some ~16 months on this game so you could become an artist of the future. The best of them all, actually.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/58eec9f3b1771872af7c94beb1b8d603f48ce8ec.gif[/img]


In SuchArt! nothing limits your creativity: you can paint whatever and wherever you want. And no matter which tool you choose — brush, spoon or even a flamethrower — the result will only depend on your skill! You can also sell your masterpieces or expose them in your own virtual gallery, as true art deserves to be shared. 

I’ve prepared a demo of SuchArt! specially for the Steam Games Festival. This demo features a separate room (a virtual studio instead of a real one you’ll get in the full game) with a limited amount of tools and an introductory part of the story. However, you’ll be able to test the core game mechanics and take a couple of commissions from virtual clients, and I really hope you enjoy it!
